summary: An open-hour TOC discussion on conference ROI and networking, led by Bhakti Shah, Amrita Ghulati, and Devesh Lathi with member contributions. The group noted that roughly 80% of the room identifies as introverted at networking events, and shared tactics including the 30-second/3-minute/30-minute pitch framework for respecting group time, and the 'Plate Space' rule of inviting solo attendees to join a table. The session closed with practical post-event advice: block calendar time for follow-ups immediately, since inboxes flood quickly after a conference.
keyInsights: ~80% of the room self-identified as introverts in conference/networking settings.
'Plate Space' rule: proactively invite solo attendees to join your table or group.
30-second / 3-minute / 30-minute pitch framework helps respect other people's time in group settings.
